José Ramírez flies out to left fielder Chandler Simpson.
Chase DeLauter flies out to center fielder Jonny DeLuca.
Jo Adell pops out softly to first baseman Jonathan Aranda in foul territory.

Liam Hicks pops out softly to pitcher Shawn Armstrong.

Patrick Bailey flies out to right fielder Victor Mesa Jr.

rbi_if_error: Rule 9.04(a)(3) cannot apply: it requires fewer than two outs and a runner on third base. Rule 9.04(a)(1) requires the run to be "unaided by an error", so no RBI is credited for this error-dependent run.
rbi_if_hit: A run that scores on a hit is credited an RBI under Rule 9.04(a)(1), subject to the Rule 9.04(b) exceptions and the scorer's judgment; this feed row does not settle any exception.
rbi_if_fc: A run-scoring fielder's choice is one of the plays Rule 9.04(a)(1) lists, so an RBI can be credited, subject to the Rule 9.04(b) exceptions and the scorer's judgment; this feed row does not settle any exception.
